description.narrative: Insatsen avser att tömma FSO Safer på råolja för att minska risken för en miljökatastrof i Rödahavet.
The contribution aims at removing oil from the decrepit FSO Safer in order to reduce the risk of an environmental disaster in the Red Sea.
The intervention has one objective, which is to prevent a potential oil spill from the FSO Safer.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
The main outcome was the transfer of oil from FSO Safer to the new vessel that has significantly reduced the risk of an environmental disaster in the Red Sea. This was achieved by the implementation of the activities 1-4 which were successful despite that the demucking of FSO Safer's tanks could not be conducted as planned.
Also, the purchase of the vessel to replace FSO Safer turned out to be more expensive than predicted due to market fluctuations. This increased expenditures for phase 1 of the project leaving the final part of the project that focuses on implementing the permanent storage solution under funded. This phase was not part of the package of activities that Sweden was funding but the increased financial needs introduces challenges for the long-term sustainability of the project.
It is assessed that the objectives of the activates funded by Sweden were achieved.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
